US-Iran Tensions Escalate Amidst Military Actions and Rhetoric

Tensions between the United States and Iran have intensified following an attack on a U.S. base in Jordan that resulted in casualties. Iran's Supreme Leader has issued warnings against U.S. actions, while Iran has declared it is suspending a ceasefire deal, citing U.S. violations. The situation raises concerns about a potential return to wider conflict.
